editorial:
Five years after Sophie meets her three dads, she is getting ready to open her mother Donna’s hotel on a sunny Greek island. The story jumps back to 1979, when young Donna meets the three men who could be Sophie’s father. You get a bright mix of music, romance, and family drama, with big ABBA songs and gorgeous island views. It feels warm, silly, and full of heart, even when the plot gets a little messy. If you like musicals and feel-good stories, this one pulls you in quickly.

The cast is charming, especially the younger versions of the characters, and the musical numbers are colorful and fun. The pacing moves fast, though some jokes land better than others and the story can feel crowded. Still, the emotional ending gives the movie a sweet payoff. Watch it if you want a cheerful night in with friends or family. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best sound and picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Sophie opens the hotel and celebrates with her family, including her three fathers. Donna’s spirit appears to watch over the moment, showing she is still with them. Sophie also reveals she is pregnant, passing the family story forward. The movie ends with a big musical finale that brings everyone together, turning grief into joy and making the hotel opening feel like a fresh start for the whole family.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves musicals, ABBA songs, and warm family stories.
